scope: Chapter6 Gaussian simulation only; whole dissertation remains open
seed_rule: 34000 + replicate*48 + mechanism_index*16 + (q-2)*4 + missing_index; same as preserved baseline
operational_stop_rules: Stop dispatch at fixed requested walltime or jobcount, independent of estimates/significance
Pause dispatch on missing/corrupt outputs or systemic process failure
Pause dispatch when cgroup memory exceeds85percent
Resume only from hash-verified checkpoints; preserve failed attempts and all requested denominators
scientific_stop_rule: Attempt all1000 datasets per condition; no optional early stopping on favorable significance. Invalid fits remain in requested denominators; their estimates do not enter valid-fit summaries.
fit_validity: Declared production_guards.R thresholds; status0, finite estimates/objective/Jacobian, finite symmetric positive-definite Hessian and parameter/expected covariances, acceptable conditioning, nonnegative untruncated delta variances. Failures retained, no silent clipping or dropping.
baseline: Preserve all original1920fits and summaries byte-for-byte. Refit0-19 only as guarded validity audit; those are repeated datasets, not additional replication counts. Report old baseline, new unique trials and guarded replays separately.
uncertainty: Preserve prior108primarySE,36sensitivitySE,216sourceSE and72MARbias families; transformations and bias additions remain exploratory. At interim checkpoints, intervals are descriptive fixed-n summaries, not sequential testing rules. Unknown source Monte Carlo uncertainty remains missing.
failure_policy: A completed invalid fit is a recorded attempt, not automatically retried. Errors/timeouts remain in manifests and checkpoints. Any later retry requires a new attempt directory, retained original failure, declared change and deduplication by dataset/method. Do not replace unsuccessful datasets with new seeds.
independence: Guarded fitter, batch execution and baseline share model, data, engines and seeds; this is numerical validation and production continuation, not independent empirical replication.
